content.short: ZEROBASE is a CeDeFi staking platform where stablecoin deposits back its ZK prover network and earn delta-neutral yield.
content.description: ZEROBASE runs a network of nodes that generate zero-knowledge proofs, and provers must stake stablecoins to take part. Users can deposit USDT, USDC and other stablecoins into the Super Strategy pool, where funds earn from arbitrage and delta-neutral trades routed through Binance. The execution is verified with zero-knowledge proofs, and the contracts have been audited by OpenZeppelin, Salus and PeckShield. Deposits currently earn a base rate plus an extra reward for the prover network, and the app includes a bridge and a dashboard for tracking stakes.
content.meta: Stake stablecoins behind a ZK prover network and earn delta-neutral CeDeFi yield. Explore ZEROBASE CeDeFi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
